name: Variant: $500/month basic income, deficit-financed
description: The same $500 monthly payment to every adult with the 30% AI tax covering a small part and the deficit the rest. About $1.7 trillion a year of deficit spending is outside the model's fiscal range (it has no inflation, interest-rate or debt response), so its employment effect is overstated; the run is kept only to show the validity flag (meta.validity.fiscal_warning). Read the tax-financed run (policy-ubi-ai-tax) for the policy's effect.
